chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The worst of the Jews are the Jews of Baysaan, and the worst of the Christians are the Christians of Najran, and the best of the water upon the face of the earth is the water of Zamzam, and the worst of the water upon the face of the earth is the water of Barhout, and it is a valley in Hazramaut, upon which the spirits of the disbelievers and their evil ones descend.'

key_terms.بَرَهُوتَ: Barhout, a valley in Yemen, identified as the location of the worst water.
key_terms.بَيْسَانُ: Baysaan, a city in Palestine, identified here as the home of the worst Jews.
key_terms.حَضْرَمَوْتَ: Hazramaut, a region in southern Yemen where the valley of Barhout is located.
key_terms.زَمْزَمَ: Zamzam, the sacred well in Mecca, identified as the best water on earth.
key_terms.نَجْرَانَ: Najran, a region in Yemen, identified here as the home of the worst Christians.
key_terms.هَامُ الْكُفَّارِ: The spirits or souls of the disbelievers, which are said to descend upon the water of Barhout.

ai.seo_question: What is the worst water on earth and which disbelievers' spirits are associated with it?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* (Chapter 92) identifies the Jews of Baisan and Christians of Najran as the archetypes of their communities' spiritual decline, a classification often linked to their historical opposition to the Ahl al-Bayt. It contrasts the purifying waters of Zamzam with Barhout in Hadramawt, which is described as the abode of the *hamm* (souls/spirits) and *sada* (evil entities) of the disbelievers, reflecting the Shia cosmological view of the afterlife states of specific historical groups.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The most evil of the Jews are the Jews of Baysaan, and the most evil of the Christians are the Christians of Najran, and the best of the water upon the surface of the earth is the water of Zamzam, and the most evil water upon the surface of the earth is the water of Barhout, and it is in a valley of Hazramout (in south Yemen), whereby camp the spirits of Infidels and their evil ones’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah has said, ‘

The worst ones among Jews are the Jews of Baysan, the worst ones among Christians are the Christians of Najran. The best water on earth is the water of Zamzam and the worst water on earth is the water of Barahut and it is in the valley of Hadramawt where the souls and spirits of unbelievers camp.’”
